data_description.boiler_overrun: Valves stay open this long after the boiler stops. It should be at least as long as the pump overrun of the boiler.
data_description.boiler_demand_threshold: Weighted demand of all rooms that starts the boiler.
data_description.boiler_demand_hysteresis: The boiler stops below the threshold minus the hysteresis.

data_description.combine: How the demand threshold and the number of calling rooms are combined.

data_description.startup_grace: Outputs are not switched until all required entities are available, at most this long.
data_description.fault_recovery_time: How long the boiler must be available and match the command before leaving the fault state.
data_description.heartbeat_entity: Toggled periodically for a hardware watchdog, for example in Loxone.

data_description.idle_valve_policy: De-energized means that NO valve heads are open and draw no power.
data_description.exercise_duration: At least the valve travel time + 60 s.

equithermal_confirm.title: Check the heating curve
equithermal_confirm.description: The design flow temperature {design_flow_temp} °C is above the water temperature set on the boiler {boiler_fixed_flow_temp} °C. The duty limit will then have little effect for most of the winter. Save anyway?

data.frost_idle_max: Maximum boiler idle time in frost

presence.title: Presence and preheating
presence.description: Who is home comes from a presence module, a group of persons or zone.home. When nobody is home, rooms in auto use the setback; during a long absence the whole house uses away. Preheating starts early enough to have comfort when the schedule switches to comfort or when someone is expected back.

data_description.house_presence_entity: On or home = somebody is home. A number (zone.home) above 0 also means home. Unavailable keeps the last state.
data_description.long_away_entity: On = weekend or holiday: the whole house uses the away temperatures.
data_description.expected_return_entity: Timestamp of the next return, used for preheating.
data_description.absence_preset: Setback suits short absences: the house does not cool down too much.
data_description.preheat_enabled: Learns how fast each room heats up and starts heating ahead of time.
data_description.preheat_max: Preheating never starts earlier than this before the target time.
